canonical_project: KommunalBIT legacy Schwabach municipal data center
notes: KommunalBIT history says the organization began on 2010-01-01 with three locations, each with a data center, before consolidation into a central infrastructure. Schwabach's digital strategy says the city founded KommunalBIT with Fuerth and Erlangen in 2010 and uses it as an external IT infrastructure provider. Current physical status of any Schwabach-local facility is not clear, so status is unknown.
